patches.name: Endless Fall & 3-Lives
patches.description: Replaces instant fall-death with continuous falling onto previous platforms with live score reduction, adds a 3-lives HUD system with balanced fall damage and monster/UFO damage with brief invulnerability, and tracks Peak Score. Black Holes remain instant Game Over.
